Reliable Content Extraction

A crawler should preserve meaningful prose while removing interface chrome, embedded programs, and invisible content.

The main element is the preferred source when an article element is absent, so the result remains predictable.

  1. Parse the document
  2. Remove noisy nodes
  3. Normalize readable text

Escaped values such as research & development must be decoded before downstream processing.
